easyPrerequisites: Iceberg has at least one ice counter on it.
description:
Cast Memnite by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Palinchron by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
When Palinchron enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
